connector.name: Talkthrough MCP
connector.registryDescription: Local MCP server: screen recordings into transcript, exact frames, OCR, wall-clock evidence.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package talkthrough-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the korovin-aa97 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: TALKTHROUGH_WHISPER_MODEL
env.description: Whisper model (tiny|base|small|medium|large-v3|large-v3-turbo). Default: small. Use large-v3-turbo for non-English narration; the process_media `model` param overrides per call.

env.name: TALKTHROUGH_OCR
env.description: Set to 'off' to disable OCR of keyframes. Default: on.

env.name: TALKTHROUGH_OCR_LANG
env.description: Recognition script for on-screen text: a language code (ru, ja, ko, ar, hi, ...) or a RapidOCR pack name (eslav, cyrillic, ...). Default: Latin+Chinese.
